label: Today You Will Learn
h: How to tell an observation from an interpretation, consider other explanations, and choose whether to ask, wait or let go.
body:
About 8 minutes, plus one short pause · one small practice · no homework list

This lesson is about stories built from too little evidence. A clear pattern of harm is a reason to seek help, not to keep interpreting.

label: Key Scripture
h: "Love bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things."

label: Meet Mark
h:
Three weeks of silence.
Two men, each certain he knew what the other was thinking. Each wrong.

label: Name The Pattern · Mind-Reading
h: Assuming you know what someone thinks, feels or intends, without enough evidence, and responding to the assumption as fact.
body: Acted on, it can produce the very outcome it predicted.

label: The Main Truth · Four Different Kinds Of "Knowing"
body:
Observation"He has not replied to my last four messages."
Interpretation"He is avoiding me."
PatternObservations that repeat over months.
KnowledgeEstablished by evidence or disclosure.

The moment a word like "ignored" or "snubbed" enters the sentence, you have left observation.

label: The Tool · Other Possible Explanations
h: Generate two or three. Then stop.
body: Not to prove the kind one true. To show yourself that the unkind one is not the only one, and therefore that you do not know.

label: A Common Belief · "I Am Not Assuming. I Am Discerning."
body:
DiscernmentNotices, holds it loosely, tests it, is willing to ask, is willing to be wrong.
Mind-readingNotices, concludes, closes. Rarely asks. Has usually already acted.

The test: can I state the evidence, stay open to correction, and revise when new information appears?

label: Then Choose One
body:
AskWhere it is safe and worth it. Once. "I noticed you've been quiet lately. Is everything all right?"
WaitWhen asking is not yet appropriate. Ordinary respect meanwhile.
Let it goWhen you do not know, it does not much matter, and the story has one observation in it.

label: Do This Now
h: Take one person you have been "reading" this week. Write the observation on one line, and your interpretation on the next.
body:
Then two other explanations. Then one word: Ask, Wait, or Let go.

Pause the audio

label: Remember
h: Charity fills the gaps in the evidence. It is not a substitute for it.

label: Prayer
body:
Father, you alone see the heart.

Forgive me for the verdicts
I have passed on silence.

Give me the humility to say "I do not know,"
and the courage to ask.

Amen.
